question_text: Describe how unsupervised clustering of visitor records could help a museum plan services, and give one limitation.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Use features such as visit frequency, group size and interests to form similar groups without preassigned labels. Different groups may suggest family activities or specialist tours. Results depend on selected features and may hide differences within a cluster, so staff should investigate before treating every member alike.
